John Lykouretzos decreased its stake in Autodesk Inc (ADSK) by 0.67% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hoplite Capital Management Lp sold 5,432 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.54% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by John Lykouretzos held 804,446 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $101.02M, down from 809,878 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hoplite Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Autodesk Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $29.26B market cap company. The stock increased 3.42% or $4.42 during the last trading session, reaching $133.52. About 2.08 million shares traded. Autodesk, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADSK) has risen 16.56% since June 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.99% the S&P500.
Kemper Corp Master Retirement Trust decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 13.98% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 55,400 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $9.30 million, down from 64,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kemper Corp Master Retirement Trust who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $935.06B market cap company.
